newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Great Belt Fixed Link ups 4% bond amount.
newsitem.headline: Danish Great Belt Fixed Link ups 4% bond amount.

text.p: Denmark's Great Belt Fixed Link (A/S Storebaeltsforbindelsen) raised an existing four percent bond due August 15, 2005 by 300 million crowns to 500 million crowns, arranger Den Danske Bank said in a statement distributed by Copenhagen Stock Exchange on Friday.
It said the issue was to fund financing requirements in connection with the construction of the road-rail, train-car fixed link between the main Danish islands of Zealand and Funen.
The issue is to be listed on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange from April 9, it added.
